text.name: TextDesc2
text.text: MAME is an open-source emulator project created to preserve arcade hardware and software. It supports thousands of arcade systems from early electro-mechanical machines through later arcade platforms. MAME documents the original hardware, allowing games to be preserved and played on modern computers. The project supports a wide range of manufacturers including Atari, Sega, Namco, Capcom, Konami, and SNK. Its focus is on accuracy and preservation rather than only game playback.
